name: all_tools_one_each
audit:
=== IAM ===
FINDING: dev-admin | SEVERITY: CRITICAL | REASON: Has AdministratorAccess attached, full account takeover if keys leak. | FIX: Detach admin policies and attach read-only.

=== S3 ===
FINDING: acme-public-assets | SEVERITY: CRITICAL | REASON: Bucket allows public read, data exposure. | FIX: Enable block public access.

=== VPC ===
FINDING: vpc-0a1b2c3d | SEVERITY: HIGH | REASON: Flow logs disabled, no network visibility. | FIX: Enable flow logs to CloudWatch.

=== Security Groups ===
FINDING: sg-0f9e8d7c | SEVERITY: HIGH | REASON: Allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22. | FIX: Revoke the open ingress rule.

=== EC2 ===
FINDING: i-0123456789abcdef0 | SEVERITY: HIGH | REASON: IMDSv1 enabled, SSRF credential theft risk. | FIX: Require IMDSv2.

=== RDS ===
FINDING: prod-db | SEVERITY: CRITICAL | REASON: Publicly accessible database. | FIX: Disable public access.

=== Lambda ===
FINDING: payment-processor | SEVERITY: HIGH | REASON: Execution role has wildcard permissions. | FIX: Replace with least-privilege role.

=== CloudTrail ===
FINDING: main-trail | SEVERITY: HIGH | REASON: Logging is disabled. | FIX: Re-enable logging.
